sloka: उक्तश्च मधुरां वाणीं तया स मदानार्दितः ।सीतया तव किं कार्यं महेन्द्रसमविक्रम ।। ५.५८.७६ ।।।।
transliteration: uktaśca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ tayā sa madānārditaḥ ।sītayā tava kiṁ kāryaṁ mahendrasamavikrama ।। 5.58.76 ।।।।

translations.english: "She spoke sweetly to Ravana, who was tormented by the god of love saying, 'For what purpose do you desire Sita? You are equal to Mahendra in might'.
